We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. （HP：Learn more about Astellas） Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?  We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact. 【募集の背景 / Purpose & Scope】This is a pharmacologist position developing anti-cancer drugs, including antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), multi-specific antibodies or engineered small molecules. Discovery, Tumor Microenvironment group is at the forefront of Astellas Oncology Research, leveraging cutting-edge science and technologies to identify and validate novel therapeutic targets and concepts. For instance, through collaboration with our academic partners at the Kashiwa-no-ha TME iLab, located in the center of the Kashiwa-no-ha Life Science Ecosystem, we integratively leverage advanced methods like single-cell transcriptome analysis, spatial transcriptome analysis, and multiplex IHC on clinical samples to discover new targets. title: Thought Leader Liaison Gastroenterology Midwest
description: Job Title: R2872676 Thought Leader Liaison Gastroenterology MidwestLocation: Midwest Territory (Michigan, Ohio, Indiana, Illinois)About the Job:Sanofi, a global and diversified healthcare leader, discovers, develops, and distributes therapeutic solutions focused on patients' needs. Sanofi has core strengths in the field of healthcare with eight growth platforms: diabetes solutions, human vaccines, innovative drugs, rare diseases, rare blood disorders, consumer healthcare, emerging markets, and animal health. Sanofi is listed in Paris (EURONEXT: SAN) and in New York (NYSE: SNY).  Sanofi is dedicated to making a major positive impact on the lives of people with serious diseases. Summary:Sanofi's Gastroenterology Thought Leader Liaison Team is expected to possess a high level of clinical and customer knowledge, have experience with both field and headquarters protocols and procedures, and possess drive and spirit to engage and influence KOLs to help build educational platforms and inform the execution of current and future brand and disease-state strategies in three core areas: Market Insights, KOL Engagement, and Commercial HCP Speaker Bureau. The Dupixent franchise is a patient centric organization responsible for delivering the highest quality education and service regarding disease and treatment.  The goal of the franchise is to penetrate existing and new markets to meet business goals by educating physicians and healthcare professionals on Dupixent’s approved indications while upholding the Company's mission and values.    The EOE Thought Leader Liaison, Dupilumab role is a field-based, national marketing role working closely with gastroenterology U.S Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and cross-functional partners.  The Gastroenterology TLL will work closely with other field professionals including but not limited to National Sales Directors, Zone Business Directors, Regional Business Directors, Area Business Managers, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Sales, and Market Access.  The behaviors that are critical for success are ability to plan and execute long-term strategy cross-functionally through collaboration, communication, and relationship building.  The Gastroenterology TLL will report directly to the Head, Respiratory Thought Leader Liaisons.  All TLL interactions are always within label, and consistent with commercial compliance, legal and regulatory guidelines.Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs. About Sanofi:We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Main Responsibilities:Work on problems of diverse scope where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.Play a key role in enhancing the understanding of GI diseases and the role of dupilumab in the management of those diseases using on label materials.Effectively partner with alliance partner, Regeneron, to develop and execute GI KOL national strategy.Effectively manage the GI TLL budget against key brand prioritiesAssemble and lead cross-functional teams toward a shared vision of success.Aligning with cross functional account plans and teams, the Gastroenterology TLL orchestrates resources with the top 10%-15% of identified KOLs.Responsible for execution of regional insight meetingsIdentify, profile, cultivate, and maintain long-term relationships with KOLs within the gastroenterology community to conduct substantial on-label business conversations.Share KOL insights with marketing and senior leadership and provide feedback to commercial leadership on various topics (directed insights) as requested.Identify, develop, and measure KOL advocacy aligned to key brand messages. Enhance KOL organizational relationships through compliant engagements with senior leaders, medical, marketing and other internal brand partners.The Gastroenterology TLL serves as the point of contact for the gastroenterology KOLs to the organization and is responsible for collaborating with field sales for promotional program scheduling with speakers.Assisting with on-label KOL development, including speakers, with approved decks and materials in collaboration with Medical Science Liaisons.Plan and execute KOL engagements and executive encounters during field engagements, local, regional, and national conferences, POAs, and other venues in a complaint manner. Provide speaker recommendations to marketing when requested; identify emerging opinion leaders.Execute a customer centric needs-based approach with targeted KOLs. About

title: [PX] 人事部, PX Employee Relations
description:
1. 職務概要本ポジションは、ピープルエクスペリエンス（PX）部門 人事部に所属し、患者さんへの貢献および企業価値の向上を支える人事施策や人事オペレーションの推進を通じて、組織力の強化と従業員体験の向上に貢献する。

上司やマネージャーの指導・サポートを得ながら、パフォーマンスカルチャーの醸成、人事関連規程の運用、人事労務管理、人事オペレーションの効率化、部門横断プロジェクトへの参画など、人事領域における幅広い業務を担当する。

また、国内外のステークホルダーや外部ベンダーと連携し、グローバル施策や部門横断プロジェクトの円滑な実行を支援する。

さらに、生成AIやデジタルツールを日常業務に適切に取り入れ、定型業務の効率化、情報整理、資料作成および業務品質の向上に取り組み、より生産性の高い働き方の実現に貢献する。

2. 主要な役割と責任2.1 人事施策の企画・運営支援上司やマネージャーの指導・サポートを得ながら、PX戦略および事業戦略に基づく人事施策の企画・運営を支援する。

パフォーマンスマネジメント関連施策の運営を通じて、社員の成果と成長を促す組織文化の醸成に貢献する。

グローバルで展開される人事施策やプログラムについて、日本への導入および運用を支援する。

関係者への案内、説明資料の作成、会議・説明会の運営など、人事施策の実行に必要な業務を担当する。

 

2.2 労務管理・規程運用支援労働協約、就業規則および人事関連諸規程の運用・管理業務を担当する。

法改正、判例、社会動向および労務関連情報の調査を行い、規程改定や制度運用の見直しを支援する。

規程や制度に関する資料、社内案内および関連文書の作成・更新を行う。

社内協業先からエスカレーションされた従業員およびマネージャーからの人事労務関連の問い合わせに対応し、必要に応じて上司や担当者へ相談・報告する。

2.3 オペレーショナルエクセレンスGBS、Payroll、Benefits、HR Operations等の関係者と協働し、人事オペレーションの効率化および標準化を推進する。

雇用管理デスクを含む外部委託先の運営状況をモニタリングし、上司やマネージャーと連携して必要な改善活動を支援する。

労働時間管理、有給休暇取得促進、36協定関連業務等の運用を担当する。

マネージャーおよび従業員向けの研修・説明会について、資料や案内の準備、日程調整および当日の運営を行う。

生成AI、Microsoft Copilotその他の会社が承認したデジタルツールを活用し、情報整理、文書・資料作成、会議準備および定型業務の効率化と生産性向上に取り組む。

2.4 プロジェクト参画・PMOサポート上司、マネージャーまたはプロジェクトリーダーの指導・サポートのもと、人事領域における部門横断プロジェクトおよびグローバルプロジェクトへ、プロジェクトメンバーとして参画する。

プロジェクトの進捗管理、会議運営、資料作成、議事録作成および関係者との連絡・調整等のPMO業務を担当する。

国内外のステークホルダーと連携し、プロジェクトの円滑な遂行に貢献する。

AIやデジタルツールを適切に活用し、プロジェクト関連情報の整理、資料作成、会議準備およびフォローアップ業務の効率化を図る。

3. 必要な能力・スキル3.1 行動特性上司やマネージャーからの指導、フィードバックおよびサポートを積極的に取り入れながら、担当業務を着実に遂行できる。

多様なバックグラウンドを持つ国内外のステークホルダーと、相互の専門性を尊重しながら協働できる。

変化や曖昧さのある環境に柔軟に対応し、新たな課題にも前向きに取り組める。

将来的にEmployee Relations Manager、People Experience Business Partner（PXBP）など、人事領域においてより高度な役割へチャレンジし、キャリアを発展させる成長意欲を有する。

人事・労務領域における経験を積みながら、自らの専門性と責任範囲を段階的に広げていく意欲を有する。

新しいテクノロジーやAIツールに関心を持ち、日常業務の中で積極的に試行し、業務効率化や品質向上につなげられる。

機密性の高い情報を適切に取り扱い、高い倫理観、誠実さおよび責任感を持って行動できる。

複数の業務について優先順位を判断し、期限を意識して正確に遂行できる。

3.2 テクニカルスキル労働法令、人事労務またはコンプライアンスに関する基礎的な理解、またはこれらを積極的に習得する意欲

論理的思考力および情報を正確に整理する能力

Microsoft Word、Excel、PowerPoint等を使用した文書・資料作成スキル

正確かつ分かりやすい社内文書、案内および説明資料を作成する能力

生成AI、Microsoft Copilotその他のデジタルツールを活用し、業務効率化とアウトプット品質の向上につなげる能力

4. 職務経験必須要件人事領域における実務経験は不問

企業、官公庁、コンサルティングファーム、その他の組織における実務経験

将来的にEmployee Relations Manager、PXBP等の人事ポジションへキャリアを発展させる意欲を有すること

歓迎要件グローバル環境または多国籍企業における3年程度の人事経験

5. 学歴・資格必須要件学士号以上、または同等の知識・能力を有すること

6. 語学力日本語ネイティブレベル、または業務を正確かつ円滑に遂行できる同等レベルの日本語力

英語本ポジションでは、Global PXを含む海外ステークホルダーとの会議、メール、資料作成およびプロジェクト上の連携が発生するため、実務で使用できるビジネスレベルの英語力を採用上の必須要件とする。

以下の業務を英語で遂行できること。（英語力は入社後の習得を前提とするものではなく、入社/異動時点で下記業務を遂行できることを求める。）

会議において、質問への回答、確認、意見交換および必要なフォローアップができる。

英語によるメール、チャットおよび業務文書を自立して作成できる。

必要に応じて、英語による資料作成およびプレゼンテーションを行うことができる。

English Version1. Position SummaryThis position belongs to the Human Resources Department within the People Experience (PX) organization and contributes to strengthening organizational capability and enhancing the employee experience by supporting HR initiatives and HR operations that enable contributions to patients and enhance corporate value. Under the guidance and support of supervisors and managers, the role is responsible for a broad range of HR activities, including fostering a performance culture, operating HR-related policies, supporting employee relations and HR administration, improving HR operational efficiency, and participating in cross-functional projects. The position also supports the smooth execution of global initiatives and cross-functional projects by collaborating with domestic and international stakeholders and external vendors. In addition, the role appropriately incorporates generative AI and digital tools into daily work to improve productivity, streamline routine tasks, organize information, prepare materials, and enhance the quality of deliverables.

2. Description of Primary Roles & Responsibilities2.1 Culture & HR ProgramsWith guidance and support from supervisors and managers, support the planning and execution of HR initiatives aligned with the PX strategy and business strategy. Contribute to building an organizational culture that encourages employee performance and growth through the operation of performance management-related initiatives. Support the implementation and operation of global HR initiatives and programs in Japan. Prepare employee communications, briefing materials, meetings, and information sessions required for effective execution of HR initiatives.

2.2 Employee Relations & PoliciesAdminister and manage labor agreements, work rules, and other HR-related policies. Research legislative changes, court precedents, social trends, and employee relations-related information to support policy revisions and operational improvements. Prepare and update materials, internal communications, and related documents concerning policies and programs. Respond to escalated HR and employee relations inquiries from employees and managers through internal collaboration channels, and consult with or report to supervisors and relevant stakeholders as necessary.

2.3 HR Operations & Process ManagementCollaborate with GBS, Payroll, Benefits, HR Operations, and other stakeholders to improve and standardize HR operations. Monitor the operational status of external service providers, including the Employment Administration Desk, and support necessary improvement activities in collaboration with supervisors and managers. Manage operations related to working time administration, promotion of paid leave usage, and Article 36 Agreement-related processes. Prepare materials and announcements, coordinate schedules, and support the facilitation of training sessions and briefings for managers and employees. Leverage generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, and other company-approved digital tools to organize information, draft documents and materials, prepare for meetings, streamline routine tasks, and improve productivity.

2.4 Project Participation & PMO SupportParticipate as a project member in cross-functional and global HR projects under the guidance and support of supervisors, managers, or project leaders. Support PMO activities, including progress tracking, meeting coordination, preparation of materials, meeting minutes, and communication with stakeholders. Collaborate with domestic and international stakeholders to support smooth project execution. Appropriately use AI and digital tools to organize project-related information, prepare materials, support meetings, and improve follow-up activities.

3. Required Capabilities & Skills3.1 Behavioral CompetenciesAbility to steadily execute assigned responsibilities while proactively incorporating guidance, feedback, and support from supervisors and managers. Ability to collaborate with domestic and international stakeholders from diverse backgrounds while respecting each other’s expertise. Flexibility to work effectively in changing and ambiguous environments and willingness to take on new challenges. Strong growth mindset and aspiration to develop a career toward more advanced HR roles, such as Employee Relations Manager or People Experience Business Partner (PXBP). Willingness to expand expertise and scope of responsibility step by step through practical experience in HR and employee relations. Interest in new technologies and AI tools, with the ability to experiment with them in daily work and connect them to improved efficiency and quality. Ability to handle confidential information appropriately and act with high ethical standards, integrity, and accountability. Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and execute work accurately with awareness of deadlines.

3.2 Technical SkillsBasic understanding of labor laws, HR/employee relations, or compliance, or strong willingness to learn these areas. Logical thinking and ability to organize information accurately. Proficiency in preparing documents and materials using Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and related tools. Basic project coordination skills required for meeting facilitation, progress tracking, and stakeholder coordination. Ability to prepare documents, presentations, and communications in both Japanese and English. Ability to create accurate and easy-to-understand internal documents, announcements, and briefing materials. Ability to use generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, and other digital tools to improve work efficiency and the quality of outputs.

4. Work ExperienceRequiredPrior HR experience is not required. Practical work experience in a company, government organization, consulting firm, or other organization is required. Experience executing work in collaboration with multiple stakeholders under the guidance and support of supervisors or managers is required. Ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders in both Japanese and English is required. Ability to learn new digital tools and ways of working and apply them in daily operations is required. Strong motivation to develop a career in HR, including future opportunities such as Employee Relations Manager or PXBP, is required.

PreferredApproximately three years of HR experience in a global environment or multinational company is preferred. Experience working with overseas offices or global teams is preferred. Experience working with external vendors or shared service organizations is preferred. Experience using generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, or other digital tools in work is preferred. Experience using AI or digital tools to reduce routine work, shorten document preparation time, organize information, or improve work quality is preferred.

5. Education & QualificationsRequiredBachelor’s degree or equivalent knowledge and capabilities.

PreferredPreferred qualifications include Certified Social Insurance and Labor Consultant, Type I or Type II Health Officer, career counselor, or similar certifications. Other qualifications related to HR, labor relations, legal, compliance, AI, data, digital tools, or business automation are also preferred.

6. Language RequirementsJapaneseNative-level Japanese proficiency, or equivalent Japanese language ability to perform work accurately and smoothly.

EnglishBusiness-level English proficiency is a mandatory requirement for this position, as the role involves meetings, emails, document preparation, and project collaboration with overseas stakeholders, including Global PX. The required English capability must be available at the time of hiring or transfer and is not assumed to be developed after joining the role.

The incumbent must be able to participate in meetings with overseas stakeholders and proactively explain assigned responsibilities; respond to questions, confirm understanding, exchange views, and follow up as needed; independently prepare emails, chats, and business documents in English; understand English policies, guidelines, meeting materials, and business documents; maintain ongoing communication with overseas project members in global projects; and prepare materials and deliver presentations in English when required.

English Proficiency GuidelineA TOEIC score equivalent to 800 or above, or equivalent practical English communication ability sufficient to perform the responsibilities described above, is expected. In addition to test scores, actual English communication capability should be assessed through interviews or other appropriate methods.

7. Key StakeholdersInternal StakeholdersPeople Experience teams, business divisions, GBS, Payroll, Legal, Compliance, Global PX, and other domestic and international project stakeholders.

External StakeholdersCertified Social Insurance and Labor Consultants, external legal counsel, HR-related vendors, outsourced service providers such as the Employment Administration Desk, and other external partners.

8. Relevant Laws & Knowledge AreasJapanese labor-related laws, including the Labor Standards Act; labor agreements, work rules, and HR-related policies; the company code of conduct and internal policies; global policies and internal operating procedures; internal rules regarding information management, personal information protection, and handling of confidential information; and internal policies regarding the responsible use of AI and digital tools.

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.
